title: chore(doc): display some debug info when inspecting the HTML of a widget

comments.body: That's awesome, does it only toggle this mode when you click on "view html"? Or is it always activated

> That's awesome, does it only toggle this mode when you click on "view html"? Or is it always activated

Yes, only when you toggle -> I think it was more convenient.

Yes it's more convenient but I wonder if that's easy to understand. Actually I think that's not easy to understand at all because you trigger a tab on the right and it triggers a behavior also on the left so you would either know it's working like this or discover it by trying only (= luck).

What about a checkbox/button on the right of "widget display" in your screenshot that says "view underlying css classes" or "toggle css debug" "view class names"?
Yes good point, not yet sure where to put it to look nice.

OK, I've another proposal: always highlight the first level once the `View HTML` button is clicked, I think it's the best of the 2 worlds:

![](http://g.recordit.co/1tKe9GZDlk.gif)
Yes should be sufficient, if at some point it still not obvious we will think again
